Three common mistakes that quietly ruin great 3D prints. 🖨️💥

🔹 Poor orientation
 Fix: Tilt your model to reduce large cross-sections and lower suction forces 📐

🔹 Weak supports
 Fix: Reinforce islands and stress points, especially thin parts like weapons and fingers 🧩

🔹 Overexposure
 Fix: Lower exposure times until details stay crisp and edges remain sharp 🔍
